HOW TO USE THIS CHEAT SHEET:
- The script has mapped every Segment Callout in the CAD drawing.
- Under each Segment, you will find all Conduit Spans (ITEM#) located near that Callout.
- Spans are sorted alphabetically (A, B, C...) so you can trace the physical line.
- REMEMBER: Draftsmen break up conduit paths. You must manually add 
  broken conduits (e.g., road crossings) together in your calculator.
- STORAGE RULE: SPLT Handholes = 15 Storage. All else = 50 Storage.
